mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT H.USER_ID) FROM HTTP_ACCESS_LOG H LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = H.USER_ID WHERE H.CREATED_AT BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND H.ACCESS_TYPE = 'PAGE' AND (U.USER_ROLE IS NULL OR U.USER_ROLE != 'ADMIN')

SELECT label, COUNT(*) AS count, COUNT(DISTINCT userId) AS uniqueUsers FROM ( SELECT H.USER_ID AS userId, CASE WHEN H.REQUEST_URI = '/' OR H.REQUEST_URI LIKE '/home%' THEN '홈' WHEN H.REQUEST_URI LIKE '/project%' THEN '프로젝트' WHEN H.REQUEST_URI LIKE '/workspace%' THEN '그룹' WHEN H.REQUEST_URI LIKE '/calendar%' THEN '캘린더' WHEN H.REQUEST_URI LIKE '/note%' THEN '노트' WHEN H.REQUEST_URI LIKE '/photo%' THEN '사진첩' WHEN H.REQUEST_URI LIKE '/board%' THEN '게시판' WHEN H.REQUEST_URI LIKE '/friend%' THEN '친구' WHEN H.REQUEST_URI LIKE '/poll%' THEN '투표' WHEN H.REQUEST_URI LIKE '/chat%' THEN '채팅' WHEN H.REQUEST_URI LIKE '/common/notice%' THEN '공지사항' WHEN H.REQUEST_URI LIKE '/common/inquiry%' THEN '문의' WHEN H.REQUEST_URI LIKE '/users/myPage%' OR H.REQUEST_URI LIKE '/mypage%' THEN '마이페이지' WHEN H.REQUEST_URI LIKE '/users%' THEN '계정(로그인·가입)' ELSE '기타' END AS label FROM HTTP_ACCESS_LOG H LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = H.USER_ID WHERE H.CREATED_AT BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND H.ACCESS_TYPE = 'PAGE' AND (U.USER_ROLE IS NULL OR U.USER_ROLE != 'ADMIN') ) GROUP BY label ORDER BY count DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT TO_CHAR(H.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS logDate, COUNT(DISTINCT H.USER_ID) AS activeUsers, COUNT(*) AS pageViews FROM HTTP_ACCESS_LOG H LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = H.USER_ID WHERE H.CREATED_AT BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND H.ACCESS_TYPE = 'PAGE' AND (U.USER_ROLE IS NULL OR U.USER_ROLE != 'ADMIN') GROUP BY TO_CHAR(H.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(H.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD')

SELECT TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(H.CREATED_AT, 'HH24')) AS hour, COUNT(DISTINCT H.USER_ID) AS activeUsers, COUNT(*) AS pageViews FROM HTTP_ACCESS_LOG H LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = H.USER_ID WHERE H.CREATED_AT BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND H.ACCESS_TYPE = 'PAGE' AND (U.USER_ROLE IS NULL OR U.USER_ROLE != 'ADMIN') GROUP BY TO_CHAR(H.CREATED_AT, 'HH24') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(H.CREATED_AT, 'HH24')

SELECT TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(H.CREATED_AT, 'ID')) AS weekday, TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(H.CREATED_AT, 'HH24')) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS count FROM HTTP_ACCESS_LOG H LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = H.USER_ID WHERE H.CREATED_AT BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND H.ACCESS_TYPE = 'PAGE' AND (U.USER_ROLE IS NULL OR U.USER_ROLE != 'ADMIN') GROUP BY TO_CHAR(H.CREATED_AT, 'ID'), TO_CHAR(H.CREATED_AT, 'HH24') ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT CASE WHEN H.USER_AGENT IS NULL THEN '알 수 없음' WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(H.USER_AGENT, 'Mobi|Android|iPhone|iPad', 'i') THEN '모바일' ELSE 'PC' END AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM HTTP_ACCESS_LOG H LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = H.USER_ID WHERE H.CREATED_AT BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND H.ACCESS_TYPE = 'PAGE' AND (U.USER_ROLE IS NULL OR U.USER_ROLE != 'ADMIN') GROUP BY CASE WHEN H.USER_AGENT IS NULL THEN '알 수 없음' WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(H.USER_AGENT, 'Mobi|Android|iPhone|iPad', 'i') THEN '모바일' ELSE 'PC' END ORDER BY count DESC
